info.name: LJVIS — Drive Rest Forms (Driver + Teammate)
info.description: Functional tests for /control-forms/drive-rest-form/{driver|teammate} endpoints. Covers permission boundaries (sp_driver_form.write/read, sp_teammate_form.write/read), backend validation (compoundFormKey required), version/status lifecycle (saved → confirmed, saved-state no-version-bump rule, already_confirmed), and GET by id and by compound form key. Self-contained: authenticates and creates its own compound form + sub-forms.
